basic_details.job_title: DCCM Thanjavur Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: District Climate Change Mission Thanjavur (DCCM Thanjavur) has notified 1 vacancy for the Technical Assistant post on a contract basis, requiring applications to be sent by email or submitted in physical form to the District Collectorate, Thanjavur, on or before 21 October 2026. The engagement is for a period of 19 months. Applicants must hold an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy or similar fields, along with basic typing skills in both Tamil and English, and must be residents of Thanjavur District. The pay for the post is

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy, or similar/allied fields. Candidates must also possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English. | Experience and Skills: Minimum 1 year relevant work experience will be given priority. Relevant experience, particularly in a Government Department or Government Office, will be preferred. Experience in Data Entry, Data Management, official file maintenance, record keeping, and documentation. Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint. Ability to prepare official reports, letters, statements, and PowerPoint presentations, along with data compilation, tabulation, and office documentation. Good communication, coordination skills, and ability to coordinate with Government Departments and relevant stakeholders. | Eligibility Conditions: The candidate must be a resident of Thanjavur District and should not have exceeded 40 years of age as on the date of application.

selection_process: The selection process consists of the following stages:
Scrutiny of Applications In-person Interview Typing Test
A waiting list of 2–3 candidates may be maintained as per the District Climate Change Mission guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Technical Assistant post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The post is on a contract basis under the District Climate Change Mission for a period of 19 months, as per Government sanction.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and residency requirement to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates should not have exceeded 40 years of age as on the date of application, and must be residents of Thanjavur District.

faq.question: Q3. What exact subject line should be used when applying via email?
faq.answer: The email subject line must be written as: Application for Technical Assistant – District Climate Change Mission, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Q4. What preferences are given regarding work experience for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience will be given priority, with preference for candidates having experience in a Government Department or Government Office, as well as experience in Data Entry, Data Management, and official file maintenance.
